title: Exact causal cut for recurrent Horn proof-state transport
type: frozen-model diagnostic and structural mathematics; not a new trained-model scientific advantage claim

source.checkpoint_policy: Load only original frozen AF-09 trained weights and original qualified parent receipts; no fit or source mutation

intervention.boundary: Actual carried atom codes after upstream prefix and optional selected-Q donor transplant
intervention.cut: After each unchanged native TypedLoop step and code encoder, overwrite both Q atom codes with the boundary codes before decoding
intervention.teacher: Original TypedLoop is imported verbatim using the source SHA guard
intervention.role_mapping: Physical Q slots obtained from public read_slots; invariance under permuted layouts
intervention.gradient: Retain gradients through the unchanged downstream recurrent cell and goal readout

evaluation.original_test_status: Previously inspected; accuracy changes are exploratory descriptive diagnostics only
evaluation.pairing: Two source-guarded changed-status donors for every canonical case, with identical untouched facts and public graph
metrics: correct original recipient protected Q at prefix
correct protected Q after original recurrence and causal cut
complete Q-pair correctness from correct recipient/donor prefix
conditional goal accuracy given correct prefix pair
structural_gates: Every cut carried Q code bitwise equals prefix Q code at every step
Protected Q readout exactly agrees between cut clean and cut addressed trajectories at every step
When source prefixes predict correct respective Q, the cut composed-Q predictions match Horn oracle
Original TypedLoop cell has nonzero sampled cross-Q Jacobian; cut construction gives structural zero
Independent NumPy reconstruction of affine cut Q readouts
Original source training ZIP and saved model export SHA verified
Source-bound sampled independent forward replay and complete donor roster
evaluation.scientific_judgment: Theorem/engineering invariants pass or fail independently of exploratory model accuracy; no preregistered causal-performance superiority gate

reference.finite_horn_least_fixed_point: Exact AF-05 corpus and donor oracle
reference.lean: AF-09 CI already compiled 4,176 closed synthetic Horn oracle theorems; no claim of new Lean student theorem proofs

failure_policy: Preserve AF-01 to AF-09 and their registered results, including negative controls; keep AF-10 separate, draft and unmerged; any training with causal cut needs a new prospective registration
